a.name: Litter roster
a.description: The six in one table sunk in a steel-100 tray, each row led by a round photo and name; rows become mini sheets on phones.
a.differs_from: Photo-led rows in a sunk tray with no header band, zebra or brass rules; the built tables are imageless, plain or in a card.

b.name: Payment schedule
b.description: On a steel band, three payment steps on a brass numbered rail beside a photo of a young owner with a blue puppy.
b.differs_from: A stepped rail table on a full-width steel band with a photo beside it; the built tables are imageless and plain or in a card.

c.name: Boy or girl
c.description: Two columns, boys and girls, each headed by a puppy photo; rows of price, names, colours, deposit and delivery between rules.
c.differs_from: A two-subject comparison with photo column heads, framed by rules; the built tables carry no images and use a band, zebra or brass rules.
